4. Sed aliud patet Arminiūs[?] hic refugium
lepidum fane. Deus (inquit) credentes pro
tempore eligit, non credentes reprobat, &
Deus ab æterno absolute & immutabiliter de-

immutabiliter, & constantissimo decreto

page.notes: The printed text uses long s, which is rendered here as plain s. The page number is printed as old-style figures ("2ȝ"), read here as 23. The reading "Arminiūs" is uncertain and is marked [?]. The italic words "Resp. 1." and "Contingentia" are marked as italic as they appear in the scan. The word "decre-" is hyphenated at the line end and its continuation "tum" falls on the next page. The catchword "cum" is the first word of the next page.
